question: What name and divine favor belong to the white-spired temple form?
premises: The form is characterized by a white spire.
It is then designated by that name.
It is always dear to the Lord.
inference: The white-spired form is so named and is always dear to Īśvara.
plain_english: Then it is called Sitaśṛṅga, and it is always dear to Īśvara.
